trials.name: 05_drop_0.05_0.05
trials.note: Lighter dropout: is 0.1 already too much?

trials.name: 07_l2_1.5e-3
trials.note: Interpolate L2 between control 1e-3 and v2-06 2e-3.

trials.name: 08_wd_0
trials.note: AdamW wd off on dropout body (v1 20 was fine on small net; v2 07 wd 1e-3 lost).

trials.name: 10_l2_2e-3_lr_1e-3
trials.note: L2 2e-3 + LR 1e-3. Isolated each helped; stronger L2 can compress stars (v2 control Haaland 29.3) and may need the faster step.

trials.name: 11_2.0x_l2_2e-3
trials.note: 2.0× width + L2 2e-3. v1 lesson: extra capacity only stabilized with enough L2. v2 04 (2.0×, L2 1e-3) had Haaland 32.4 H/T/F but min Jaccard 0.60.

trials.name: 12_four_layer_lr_1e-3
trials.note: 4 layers + LR 1e-3. v1 14 had best tau (0.921) but Jaccard trap 0.43 on a 1x net ending at 2 units. 1.5x dropout body + faster LR aims to keep tau and Haaland without the trap.

trials.name: 13_adam_lr_1e-3
trials.note: Plain Adam + LR 1e-3 (v1 21: highest Haaland 32.9, Jaccard only 0.60 on the small net). Dropout 09 body is the Jaccard counterweight.

trials.name: 14_huber_1_patience_40
trials.note: Huber 1.0 + patience 40. v1 11 wanted to cut pp90 outliers that reorder top-20 (v2 control pred_max 28) but may have stopped too soon; v2 08 patience alone did nothing.

trials.name: 15_historic_drop_l2_2e-3
trials.note: Historic Dropout 0.3/0.1 with L2 2e-3 (not the weak-L2 16 recipe). 16 failed as a bundle; this keeps the dropout idea and the L2 that actually worked.
